name: @designkpmg/storybook-angular
description: Dependency manifest only — declares the Angular/webpack Storybook toolchain as its own npm workspace member so its versions resolve and upgrade independently of the React app's tooling. The actual config (angular.json, .storybook-angular/) stays at the repo root and is run via the root package.json scripts (npm run storybook:angular / build-storybook:angular, both `ng run kpmg-angular:...`) — @storybook/angular's webpack preset resolves paths relative to cwd inconsistently with Angular's own workspace-relative conventions, so invoking from anywhere but the repo root breaks it. No scripts here.
